caption: The drawing shows a combination of objects rendered in pencil and subtle color. Centrally, there is a pair of long-nosed pliers depicted vertically, with the tips pointing upward and the handles pointing down, shaded in gray tones to suggest metallic material. Attached to one handle of the pliers is a curved horizontal arm, also shaded in gray, which extends to the right and supports an upright cylinder. The cylinder, shaded in dark gray, stands vertically and appears to rest above a brownish area at the bottom of the drawing, which likely represents a surface or ground rendered in a soft gradient of brown. In the upper right corner within a bordered square, there is a smaller outlined sketch repeating the main object, accompanied by a horizontal object and a zigzag line, possibly denoting a cross-sectional or functional detail. The composition is bordered by a rectangular frame, and below the main drawing are annotations that read, “Scale 3/4” = 1’” on the left and “G. Bernhardt” on the right. The background is plain and off-white.
